scope: Controlled fictional engineering fixtures; not real visitor distribution or operational guidance.

documents.title: 松林备份恢复
documents.content: 松林项目每晚创建数据库快照。恢复演练要求先在隔离目录校验快照 SHA-256，再导入临时数据库；未核验的快照不得覆盖工作库。演练完成后记录校验结果。

documents.title: 松林备份清理
documents.content: 松林的清理任务保留最近十四份每日快照，每周五删除到期文件。此流程只管理保留周期，不执行恢复演练，也不验证导入结果。

documents.title: Pine backup restoration
documents.content: Pine creates a database snapshot every night. Restoration drills first verify the snapshot SHA-256 in an isolated directory, then import it into a temporary database. Unverified snapshots must never overwrite the working database. Record the verification result after the drill.

documents.title: Pine backup retention
documents.content: Pine retention keeps fourteen daily snapshots and removes expired files on Fridays. This workflow manages retention only; it does not perform restoration drills or validate imports.

documents.title: 灯塔证书轮换
documents.content: 灯塔的站点证书轮换由值班员执行。替换证书后，值班员先运行配置检查，再平滑重载入口服务；检测失败时保留当前进程，并恢复上一份证书。

documents.title: 灯塔域名迁移
documents.content: 灯塔域名迁移先降低 DNS TTL，再逐步调整解析记录。迁移结束后观察旧域名流量。域名迁移手册不定义证书轮换与服务重载流程。

documents.title: Beacon certificate rotation
documents.content: The on-call operator rotates the Beacon site certificate. After replacing it, the operator checks the configuration before gracefully reloading the ingress service. A failed check keeps the current process running and restores the previous certificate.

documents.title: Beacon domain migration
documents.content: Beacon domain migration lowers DNS TTL before gradually updating records, then monitors traffic to the old domain. This guide does not define certificate rotation or service reloads.

documents.title: 溪流事件续传
documents.content: 溪流客户端通过 SSE 接收进度。断线重连时使用 Last-Event-ID 发送最后确认的事件编号。服务端从该编号之后续传，客户端按事件编号去重，避免重复显示同一条进度。

documents.title: 溪流连接心跳
documents.content: 溪流每隔十五秒发送一条 SSE 注释作为心跳，代理将空闲连接超时设为九十秒。心跳没有业务事件编号，不用于恢复进度。

documents.title: Brook event resumption
documents.content: Brook clients receive progress through SSE. On reconnection, Last-Event-ID carries the last acknowledged event number. The server resumes after that number, and clients deduplicate by event number to avoid displaying the same progress twice.

documents.title: Brook connection heartbeat
documents.content: Brook sends an SSE comment every fifteen seconds as a heartbeat. The proxy idle timeout is ninety seconds. Heartbeats have no business event numbers and do not resume progress.

documents.title: 纸鹤提交去重
documents.content: 纸鹤表单在首次提交时生成幂等键。网络超时后的重试必须复用同一个 Idempotency-Key；若用户修改正文，则创建新的键。服务器用键和正文摘要识别重复提交。

documents.title: 纸鹤会话过期
documents.content: 纸鹤登录会话在连续三十分钟无操作后过期。重新登录会产生新的会话标识。会话标识只用于身份认证，不是表单提交去重的幂等键。

documents.title: Crane submission deduplication
documents.content: Crane forms generate an idempotency key for the first submission. Retries after a network timeout must reuse the same Idempotency-Key; editing the body requires a new key. The server identifies duplicates using the key and body digest.

documents.title: Crane session expiration
documents.content: Crane login sessions expire after thirty minutes of inactivity. Logging in again produces a new session identifier. This authenticates the user and is not a form deduplication key.

documents.title: 苔原索引切换
documents.content: 苔原为每次完整重建创建新 generation。Worker 写入全部切片和向量后将其标为 ready_to_switch。只有 API owner 核对发布版本并完成 finalize 后，活动指针才切换到新 generation。

documents.title: 苔原查询融合
documents.content: 苔原查询把关键词排名和向量排名通过 RRF 合并，随后过滤失效发布版本。RRF 只影响结果排序，不创建 generation，也不操作索引切换指针。

documents.title: Tundra index switching
documents.content: Tundra creates a new generation for each full rebuild. The Worker marks it ready_to_switch after writing all chunks and vectors. Only the API owner can move the active pointer to the new generation after checking published versions and completing finalize.

documents.title: Tundra query fusion
documents.content: Tundra queries combine keyword and vector rankings with RRF, then filter stale published versions. RRF changes ranking only; it neither creates generations nor moves the active index pointer.

documents.title: 琥珀图片发布
documents.content: 琥珀上传的图片先写入临时目录。发布流程验证文件签名与尺寸，并删除 EXIF 位置信息，然后将文件移动到公开媒体目录。未经验证的文件不能获得公开 URL。

documents.title: 琥珀缩略图缓存
documents.content: 琥珀为已公开图片生成三种尺寸的缩略图。缓存键包含源文件摘要与目标宽度，原图改变后自动使用新键。这一过程只处理已经通过发布验证的媒体。

documents.title: Amber image publishing
documents.content: Amber uploads images to a temporary directory. Publishing validates the file signature and dimensions, removes EXIF location information, and then moves the file to public media storage. Unvalidated files cannot receive a public URL.

documents.title: Amber thumbnail caching
documents.content: Amber generates three thumbnail sizes for published images. Cache keys include the source digest and target width; changed originals get new keys. This operates only on media already validated for publication.

documents.title: 云雀队列调度
documents.content: 云雀推理进程一次只处理一个任务。排队的交互查询优先于后台建索引任务，但不会中断正在执行的推理。等待队列满时，新请求收到 429，调用方稍后重试。

documents.title: 云雀任务超时
documents.content: 云雀为请求设置三十秒响应期限。超过期限的客户端收到超时结果。CPU 推理不支持强制抢占，已经开始的任务会继续到结束，随后释放执行槽。

documents.title: Lark queue scheduling
documents.content: Lark inference handles one task at a time. Queued interactive queries take priority over background indexing, without interrupting inference already running. When the waiting queue is full, new requests receive 429 and callers retry later.

documents.title: Lark task deadlines
documents.content: Lark requests have a thirty-second response deadline. Clients receive a timeout after that deadline. CPU inference cannot be forcibly preempted; a started task finishes before releasing its execution slot.

documents.title: 星图预算结算
documents.content: 星图在发起模型请求前预留本次预算。成功响应后按供应商 usage 结算实际用量并释放剩余预留；缺失 usage 时进入待核查状态，不能当作零费用成功。

documents.title: 星图预算重置
documents.content: 星图每天按设定时区开启新的日预算窗口。上一窗口的未决账目仍需继续核查，不因为日期变化自动作废。窗口重置不修改供应商返回的用量字段。

documents.title: Atlas budget settlement
documents.content: Atlas reserves budget before sending a model request. A successful response settles actual consumption using provider usage and releases the remaining reservation. Missing usage enters a pending-review state and cannot count as a zero-cost success.

documents.title: Atlas budget reset
documents.content: Atlas opens a daily budget window in its configured timezone. Unresolved entries from the previous window still require review. Resetting the window does not change provider usage fields.

documents.title: 蕨类健康探测
documents.content: 蕨类运维脚本以 curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8091/healthz 检查进程存活。模型身份检查使用 /readyz 并携带内部 Bearer 凭据。脚本日志禁止记录 Authorization 请求头。

documents.title: 蕨类指标采样
documents.content: 蕨类每十秒记录进程工作集和队列长度，指标保存在本机滚动文件中。指标采样不发出健康探测请求，也不保存模型凭据。

documents.title: Fern health probes
documents.content: Fern checks process liveness with curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8091/healthz. Model identity checks use /readyz with an internal Bearer credential. Script logs must never record the Authorization request header.

documents.title: Fern metric sampling
documents.content: Fern records the process working set and queue length every ten seconds in local rotating files. Metric sampling does not send health probes or store model credentials.

documents.title: 砂岩版本回滚
documents.content: 砂岩回滚检索服务时把模型、tokenizer、切片规则和向量 generation 视为一套版本。先确认旧制品的摘要和配套索引仍有效，再执行受控切换；仅替换权重文件不是完整回滚。

documents.title: 砂岩页面回滚
documents.content: 砂岩静态页面使用带摘要的构建目录。页面回滚只恢复上一份前端产物，不修改检索模型和向量库。前端发布记录与检索版本记录分别保存。

documents.title: Sandstone version rollback
documents.content: Sandstone treats the model, tokenizer, chunking rules, and vector generation as one version during retrieval rollback. It verifies the old artifact digest and matching index before a controlled switch. Replacing weights alone is not a complete rollback.

documents.title: Sandstone page rollback
documents.content: Sandstone static pages use digest-named build directories. Page rollback restores the previous frontend output without changing retrieval models or vector storage. Frontend and retrieval release records are kept separately.

documents.title: 测试资料管理员
documents.content: 这是一套虚构工程资料的测试账号，仅用于本机检索回归，不代表真实作者。

documents.content: This fictional engineering corpus account exists only for local retrieval regression and does not represent a real author.
